dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: There's something going on, isn't there?

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: So it isn't just me... Everyone has their bad days...

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: But it's okay! That's just life — sometimes we get hurt, and sometimes we get to sing happy songs.

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: A heartless sailor from foreign lands once broke my heart. But look at me now, I can still dance!

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: Ah, I forgot to mention that I am a street performer. Come see me dance if you're in a bad mood!
